themes.description: Users report that the app has a bad interface design, is extremely slow, freezes frequently, and the recent upgrade introduced severe usability and data issues.
themes.business_impact: Customers abandon the app due to crashes and slow performance, missing timely trades, which directly reduces trading volume and revenue, and increases support costs.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The app’s UI layer is not optimized for large data sets and recent architectural changes added unnecessary rendering overhead, while backend data feeds are not properly integrated, leading to freezes and slow loading.
themes.action_plan:
• Conduct a performance audit and profiling of the app
• Identify and refactor heavy UI components and reduce paint work
• Rollback the problematic upgrade and restore stable UI
• Optimize data feed integration and implement proper caching
• Release incremental updates with thorough regression testing
• Monitor real‑time performance metrics and collect user feedback post‑release

themes.name: [Negative] Loss of 1‑Day Change Cross‑Broker Tracking

quotes.text: However lately it doesn't show the 1 day change of equity shares of other brokers which was a great feature of the app.
Disappointing change to 1D Change ... the recent decision to restrict the 1D Change feature to shares held through INDmoney is a bad move.
I see that you have stopped displaying 1 day changes for other brokers. Why did you make people get used to it earlier then?
The 1 day change feature should include stock price changes from other brokers as well, this was there earlier but now it only shows stocks from indmoney.

app experience changed after recent updates. earlier used to see 1 day portfolio change across your brokers from high to low with 1 tap… now after recent updates it just shows stocks purchased from indmoney.

themes.description: Users report that the app no longer displays the 1‑day price change for shares and mutual funds held with external brokers, and that sorting or viewing combined portfolio performance has been removed. This feature was a key differentiator for the platform.
themes.business_impact: Loss of value for multi‑broker users, leading to churn risk for a segment that relies on cross‑broker visibility, potential loss of revenue from cross‑broker upsell opportunities, and a spike in support tickets and negative ratings.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: A recent UI/UX redesign aimed at simplifying the interface inadvertently removed legacy 1‑day change widgets and changed the data‑sync flow to fetch only proprietary holdings, possibly to reduce API complexity or prioritize INDmoney assets.
themes.action_plan:
• Re‑introduce cross‑broker 1‑day change view in the portfolio summary
• Add an opt‑in toggle for legacy 1‑day change display
• Restore sorting by 1‑day change across all brokers
• Ensure backend supports cross‑broker data aggregation with caching
• Update UI to clearly differentiate proprietary vs external holdings
• Run regression tests on portfolio data accuracy
• Communicate the change in release notes and in‑app messaging
